caption: An aquarium pump is plugged into the wall, and bubbles start rising from the air stone in the tank.

sa.check: An aquarium tank with water and an air stone in it.
The pump's plug is pushed into a wall socket.
Bubbles rise from the air stone.
No bubbles rise before the plug goes in.
The order is plug in, then bubbles.

pc.expect: Bubbles begin at the air stone when the plug seats in the socket, and only then.
pc.fail: The plug is in and no bubbles come from the stone; or bubbles stream before the plug reaches the socket; or bubbles appear elsewhere in the tank while the stone gives none.

pc.expect: Before plugging in the water is still with no bubbles; afterwards the stream runs continuously while the plug stays in.
pc.fail: Bubbles start and stop with the plug seated and untouched; or the water surface churns before any bubble rises; or the air tubing whips about by itself.

pc.expect: Bubbles rise from the stone to the surface and break there; none sink or hover.
pc.fail: Bubbles sink toward the gravel; or hang still in the water; or run back down into the stone.

pc.expect: Where the stream reaches the surface the water ripples, and plants in the stream sway with it.
pc.fail: The stream reaches the surface and the surface directly above the stone stays glassy still; or ripples appear far from the stream while the surface above it is still; or plants far from the stream sway while those in it stay rigid.

pc.expect: One tank, one air stone, one plug; bubbles form at the stone; the tank's glass stays whole.
pc.fail: Bubbles appear from nowhere in mid-water away from the stone; or the air stone vanishes or a second one appears; or water passes through the glass; or the plug passes into the wall beside the socket.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The gravel, decorations and the tank's frame stay the same.
pc.fail: The gravel changes colour; or decorations move or change; or the air stone changes shape.

note: Fish are self-driven and are not judged.
